status: technical coverage delivered at the stated levels; distribution blocked on #627
revisions: 2026-09-28: receipt_sha256 names docs/profile-extraction-v3-receipt.json. The five ORDER_DETAIL rows are qualified at the tested choice level; component usage rows record what the pinned HL7apy archive can and cannot supply; a 2.8.2 component usage row records that conditional usage is not represented.

2026-09-28: database_receipt_sha256 names docs/profile-extraction-v4-receipt.json and conditions_sha256 docs/profile-conditions.json. Component usage, base field usage, length and terminology rows now describe the v5 packs built from the pinned HL7 v2 database export and the reviewed conditions; counts are over the elements promised structures reach.

2026-09-28: every row now describes the packs built from HL7's own schemas and chapters (docs/profile-extraction-v5-receipt.json, ADR-0026); nHapi, HL7apy, NIST's export and hl7.eu are no longer sources. Counts are over the distinct fields (first family in ADT, ORM, ORU, SIU order) and components the promised structures reach. A per-edition row lists the recorded agreement between HL7's schema and chapter. The contract is v2: database_receipt_sha256 and zero_length_components are gone, receipt_sha256 names docs/profile-extraction-v5-receipt.json.

rows.source_survey: HL7's chapters for this edition print no component attribute tables, so no component usage exists to read; HL7's schemas list each component without usage.
rows.missing: No HL7 source defines component usage for this edition. Each component is unclassified and evaluation reports each occurrence as unsupported, never optional.
rows.authoritative_source_needed: None exists for this edition; a site profile may declare component usage locally.
rows.implementation_test_needed: Covered: an unclassified component cannot pass (TestUnclassifiedUsageAndUnavailableLengthCannotPass, TestPinnedStandardPacks).
rows.release_claim_affected: No base component usage claim for this edition.

rows.source_survey: Usage (OPT) from the edition's own segment attribute tables as HL7 publishes them, the defining chapter per family for OBR and OBX; each C predicate encoded from its own edition sentence in docs/profile-conditions.json with located, hashed basis spans. Recorded: printed "(B) R" read as B: DG1.2, PR1.2.
rows.missing: Predicates are a reviewed reading of edition prose, since no machine-readable HL7 source states them. A C field whose edition states no condition or contradicts itself is unsupported; a condition that depends on information the message does not carry is undecided. Neither passes.
rows.authoritative_source_needed: Met: the edition's own segment attribute tables and definitions. Rights review (#627) is separate.
rows.implementation_test_needed: Covered: owned predicate fixtures (internal/profileeval/usage_test.go), TestPinnedStandardPacks/2.3.1 printed usage against the built pack, and the independent re-review on 2026-09-28 of all 717 encodings (477 distinct texts) against HL7's chapter text, which confirmed 439, raised 38 and led to 25 adjudicated changes across 65 elements.
rows.release_claim_affected: Field usage is evaluated from the edition's code; a conditional field passes only when its predicate is decided from the message. No full conformance claim until independently qualified and #627 is approved.
